patterns.message: The website is a React DOM app: React Native/Expo belong to apps/datahub-hr.

core is application infrastructure: it must not import modules (only the router, core/routes/index.tsx, does).
Import route paths from @/core/routes/paths. Only App.tsx imports the router.
